title: Qualifications for Overseers and Deacons

questions.question: The saying is trustworthy: If anyone aspires to the office of overseer, he desires a ____ task.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:1 (ESV): "The saying is trustworthy: If anyone aspires to the office of overseer, he desires a noble task."

questions.question: An overseer must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, sober-minded, self-controlled, respectable, ____, able to teach,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:2 (ESV): "Therefore an overseer must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, sober-minded, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,"

questions.question: Not a drunkard, not violent but ____, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:3 (ESV): "not a drunkard, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money."

questions.question: He must manage his own household well, with all dignity keeping his children ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:4 (ESV): "He must manage his own household well, with all dignity keeping his children submissive,"

questions.question: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:5 (ESV): "for if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for God's church?"

questions.question: He must not be a recent ____, or he may become puffed up with conceit and fall into the condemnation of the devil.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:6 (ESV): "He must not be a recent convert, or he may become puffed up with conceit and fall into the condemnation of the devil."

questions.question: Moreover, he must be well thought of by ____, so that he may not fall into disgrace, into a snare of the devil.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:7 (ESV): "Moreover, he must be well thought of by outsiders, so that he may not fall into disgrace, into a snare of the devil."

questions.question: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:8 (ESV): "Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for dishonest gain."

questions.question: They must hold the mystery of the faith with a ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:9 (ESV): "They must hold the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience."

questions.question: And let them also be tested first; then let them serve as deacons if they prove themselves ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:10 (ESV): "And let them also be tested first; then let them serve as deacons if they prove themselves blameless."

questions.question: Their wives likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, but sober-minded, ____ in all things.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:11 (ESV): "Their wives likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, but sober-minded, faithful in all things."

questions.question: Let deacons each be the husband of one wife, managing their children and their own ____ well.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:12 (ESV): "Let deacons each be the husband of one wife, managing their children and their own households well."

questions.question: For those who serve well as deacons gain a good standing for themselves and also great ____ in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:13 (ESV): "For those who serve well as deacons gain a good standing for themselves and also great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus."

questions.question: I hope to come to you soon, but I am writing these things to you so that, if I delay, you may know how one ought to behave in the ____ of God...
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:14-15 (ESV): "I hope to come to you soon, but I am writing these things to you so that, if I delay, you may know how one ought to behave in the household of God,"

questions.question: The church of the living God is a pillar and buttress of the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 3:15 (ESV): "the household of God, which is the church of the living God, a pillar and buttress of the truth."

key_verse_text: if I delay, you may know how one ought to behave in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, a pillar and buttress of the truth.
